title: Wren and the Alibi
author: Wendell Nystrom
blurb: Bram Marchetti, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
